svg.text: ESS-BMS-16S — System Block Diagram (Schematic v1.2 Hybrid Power Tree)
16S LFP (40.0–58.4 V) | 200 A Continuous High-Side Switch | Two-Board Stack: Power Board (Sheets 04, 07) + Control Board (Sheets 01–03, 05–06, 08–10)
POWER BOARD — 150 × 100 mm, 4L, 2 oz Cu on Al Plate (Sheets 04 & 07)
200 A HIGH-CURRENT POWER PATH & PRE-CHARGE / PRE-DISCHARGE
NT401 single-point net tie BAT− = GND_PWR
BSS131 240 V shifters pull gates low; DFETOFF
P5-01: R759 0R (DCHG kills both) vs R760 (chg)
B2B out: 10 MΩ holds off (never hot-unplug!)
TLV1702 window: +599 A DSG / −305 A CHG trip
F701 2 A / 10 kA @75 VDC supply-tap fuse
100 V FET margin → D-04 short-circuit test
F702 10 kA @75 VDC caps heater ≤ 3.5 A
External thermal cutoff in pad required
Fed from PACK+ (blocked if P5-01 kills DSG)
B2B STACK CONNECTOR J206 (Control Bottom) ↔ J701 (Power Top) — 2 × 15 Pins, 11 mm Standoffs [in v1.2]
HV Pins 1–8 (VSUP_TAP, AFE_PACK/LD, CHG/DSG×2/PCHG/PDSG) | Pins 9–10 Gap | Kelvin 11–12 | Analog 13–18 | Kill/Logic/Rails 19–30
v1.0 RC latch (1 MΩ / 1 µF → 0.46–0.66 s hold)
Non-sync COT (~321 kHz, 22 µH, SS520), 5.03 V
Gate B12: EMC pre-scan (CISPR 25 / ESS 150 kHz+)
300 mA LDO (233 mA pk); ferrite FB101 → +3V3_A
MCU, logic, kill, INA240, TLV1702, NTC bias
2 A buck (350 mA pk) for ESP32-C3; 0 µA off
100 V / ~0.47 A DC; PWM fan, heater, 2× EXT_OUT
8.02 mm pad gap + keepout; 4.90–5.05 V (no dummy)
Hardware SCD / OCD1 / OCD2 / COV / CUV / OT / UT
High-side CHG / DSG / PCHG / PDSG → J206 B2B
J_ABAL1 header (1–2 A active balancer, PTC)
AFE Pin Audit & I2C vs SPI Link
Define deep-UV cutoff & wake (no idle via PDSG)
Month drain budget + bus wake trade-off
LSE 32.768 kHz RTC (VBAT_MCU; lost in Ship)
SPI1: FM25V02A 256 Kb FRAM + GD25Q64E 8 MB flash
TMUX1308 8-ch NTC mux (pack, bal., amb., board)
10 Ω anti-surge + PSM712 TVS + 120 Ω termination
C618 1 nF 2 kV // R626 1 MΩ GND_ISO ↔ CHASSIS
J605 USB4105 + USBLC6 + CH340X + ISO7721DR (4 mm)
Service telemetry / CLI (boot ROM requires JP301)
Wi-Fi / BLE app telemetry, OTA bridge on +3V3_ESP
Gated off in Standby / Sleep (0 µA via EN_ESP)
EN_ISO is off in Sleep → no bus wake on +5V_ISO
Assess low-power wake receiver vs Standby idle
FAN_EN + 25 kHz PWM + TACH (4-wire 12 V fan)
Buzzer BZ801 (on +5V via U801): currently DNP
4 × green SOC LEDs, RUN/ALM LEDs, 4-bit DIP addr
Pinout: +3V3, GND, I2C, WAKE_BTN_RAW, LEDs, INT
Assess ISO1540 isolated I2C for long door cable
SPEC MATCH: True (10 sheets, 784 refs) | B2B: True
ERC: 0 errors both boards (2 U1002 warnings ctrl)
Open: T101 −40 °C qual, Gate B12 EMC, Ship RTC
